dos: Do prove every cheap-price claim with strikethrough + % stamp + WITA deadline on the same ticket.
Do set all money in Archivo Narrow tabular and all measurement in system mono.
Do separate rows and rails with hairline ink dividers; reserve 2px rules for section openings, masthead, and kolofon.
Do keep urgent red inside the countdown context only.
Do resolve newsletter signup inline with the emerald success status; keep empty states (category, drawer) with icon + recovery link.
donts: Don't use nested cards anywhere on this surface — wells and rows, not boxes in boxes.
Don't add autorotate to the sampul, shadows to tickets, or red outside the countdown.
Don't price anything in body or mono faces, or measure anything in display/ticket faces.
Don't invent testimonials, ratings, or new numeric claims — PRODUCT.md forbids fabricated proof.
Don't restyle the wordmark, stamp blue, marker orange, tagline, or factual copy (addresses, hours, prices).
keyCharacteristics: Paper ground (#f5efe1 / #e9dfc9) with press-ink (#1c1917) rules, never nested cards
Every cheap-price claim carries proof: strikethrough + rotated ink % stamp + midnight-WITA deadline
Condensed ticket numerals (Archivo Narrow, tabular) for all prices
Ink pills for etalase tabs; numbered rows for Paling dicari and Redaksi
Dark world is a functional ink-black counterpart, not a separate brand
narrative.overview: The homepage is a warm daily-market broadsheet, not a catalogue: paper ground, press ink, and stamp-blue proof on every price line. Density is editorial — hairline rules and numbered rows carry the rhythm, while imagery lives inside a single cover panel and a three-slot ad rail. Urgency is rationed: only the Banjir Harga band and its countdown are allowed to shout in red.

rules.body: Urgent red appears solely in the Banjir Harga deadline context; anywhere else it is a defect.
rules.name: The Countdown-Only Red Rule

rules.body: Rows, rails, and strips are separated by hairlines and rules, never cards inside cards.
rules.name: The No-Nested-Cards Rule

rules.body: Money is always set in Archivo Narrow with tabular numerals; body/mono faces never price anything.
rules.name: The Tickets-Are-Narrow Rule

rules.body: Long reading (SEO column) caps at 75ch; redaksi excerpts cap near 72ch.
rules.name: The 75ch Measure Rule

rules.body: No card shadows anywhere in the rails, grids, or rows; the two lifts above are the entire vocabulary.
rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
